records.issue_text: [BUG] TopicEmbed.import uses check-then-insert (SELECT on embed_url at line 15, then TopicEmbed.create! at line 25 inside the transaction) with no lock, while both the PollFeed job and TopicRetriever jobs can import the same URL concurrently. Two concurrent imports of the same URL both see `embed.blank?`, both create a topic/post, and the loser's TopicEmbed.create! raises on the unique embed_url index; inside Jobs::PollFeed (retry: false) that exception aborts the entire hourly run, so every remaining feed item after the duplicated one is skipped for that cycle.
